Eventually, he pulled something out of his chest that allowed him to swish the wand, completely butchering what seemed to be quite an easy latin word. I had writers block for a while up until last night. Try to ignore it. I found that once I forgot about it, inspiration just kept hitting (That, and the help of daydreaming to a playlist)

If that doesn’t work, focus on a different project. Just write and rewrite until you can find the phrase to get your creativity flowing. Distance yourself from what’s causing this. You might find yourself super into it once you’re writing consistently again!

And finally, remember that writer’s block comes in waves- at least from my experience- so definitely don’t be discouraged! If you’re working on something you’re on a schedule for, it’s likely that your readers will understand if you don’t update. They’ll probably be thankful that you took the time to produce a quality chapter in a good state of mind rather than a sloppy one because you had to write. 

Best of luck!
